implementation_authority: mounted Django URL configuration (ExoCore/urls.py + per-app urls.py)

transport_defaults.api_base: same-origin relative '/api/*' (dev: Vite proxy to 127.0.0.1:8000; prod: nginx /api/ proxy to Django :8000, proxy_buffering off for SSE)
transport_defaults.csrf: non-GET requests attach header 'X-CSRFToken' read from 'csrftoken' cookie (shared apiFetch and raw fetches)
transport_defaults.error_normalization_shared: apiFetch throws Error with .status and parsed .body (json or text)
transport_defaults.auth_model: DRF defaults (settings has no REST_FRAMEWORK dict): AllowAny permission; SessionAuthentication present but no login flows; endpoints are not user-account gated. Recorded as source fact, not a recommendation.

resources.purpose: Canonical ordinary Conversation creation for Standard and Superior (g045) agents; project optional (0 = Drift).
resources.auth_csrf: cookie credentials; CSRF header on POST

request.name: string, optional, default '新会话 <date>'
request.preset_id: int, required; must reference existing AgentPreset
request.project_id: int, optional, default 0; 0 maps to DB NULL; nonzero must exist (400 if not)
request.frozen_project_ids: list[int], optional; g045-only extension list; when omitted defaults to [project_id] or [] for project_id=0; ignored (forced []) for non-g045

success.envelope: {"msg": "会话已建立，权限已锁定。", "data": {"session_id": int, "session_name": string}}

errors.400: serializer field errors (e.g. preset_id 指定的预设ID不存在。; project_id 指定的项目ID不存在。)

semantics.drift: project_id 0 -> DB project NULL; DB NULL project is represented as project:0 in list/detail serializers
semantics.identity: returns session_id == Conversation.id; conversation created with agent_preset, frozen_project_ids (g045), thinking_level, last_platform=preset.default_model
semantics.lifecycle: no message is created by init

frontend_consumers: packages/chat-core/src/components/modals/NewSessionModal.jsx (raw fetch; payload {preset_id, name?, project_id, frozen_project_ids, thinking_level:'auto', temperature:1.0}; reads data.data.session_id)

resources.purpose: Shared wrapper createConversation() targets POST /api/agents/conversations/ which is a ListAPIView (GET only) -> no create is mounted there. Wrapper has zero SPA callers.

semantics.consumer_mismatch: packages/shared/src/endpoints/conversations.js createConversation() must not be assumed valid; canonical creation is conversation.create.init

resources.purpose: Ordinary Conversation list for Recent view.

success.note: no temperature, no is_prime in this serializer

semantics.filters: agent_preset__is_visible=True; excludes is_bridge=True and council participant/synthesis conversations
semantics.pagination: none; no server-side Agent x Project combined filter (frontend filters client-side; R2 scale trigger not met)
semantics.drift: DB NULL project serialized as project:0 sentinel; project_name null

resources.purpose: Single conversation detail, rename/preference update, delete.

PATCH_writable: memory_injection_enabled (bool or null; null inherits preset)

semantics.delete: physical delete (messages/history chunks cascade); spawns subprocess manage.py compact_conversations --prune --yes for orphan history cleanup
semantics.is_prime: perform_update reads is_prime but serializer does not expose it -> no-op today

resources.purpose: Message history of a conversation (session_id == conversation id).

query.offset: int optional; default 0 meaning 'from the newest end'

success.no_params_mode: bare array of MessageSerializer rows (legacy full-download)

semantics.offset_semantics: offset counts back from newest (offset=0 -> last `limit` messages); has_more = older messages exist

frontend_consumers: ChatArea refetch after send/stop; history paging with limit=50/offset

resources.purpose: GroupChat list and creation; separate runtime/domain identity from ordinary Conversation.

errors.400: serializer errors; {"error": "participant_id 必须为整数"}

success.GET/PATCH: 200 row fields [id, name, prompt, participant_ids, created_at]; GET does NOT nest messages

errors.400: serializer errors

semantics.no_messages_nesting: GET returns only group fields; messages live under /messages/
semantics.participant_ids_patch: PATCH replaces the whole participant_ids list (not a merge)
semantics.delete_cascade: DELETE removes the group and CASCADE-deletes its messages; 204

errors.400: serializer errors

errors.400: {"error": "message_id 不存在"} | {"error": "message_id 不属于此群聊"}

semantics.consumer_mismatch: GroupchatRoom.jsx sends {user_message_id} but the backend reads message_id -> today's live broadcast degrades to unanchored dispatch (message_id=0) and validation never fires

resources.purpose: List user attachments and tool-collection entries of a conversation.

success.envelope: bare array; user rows first then tool_collection rows
user_row_fields: storage_path (null ONLY for audio/* rows; exposed for non-audio rows)
success.note: anchored tool-collection entries are skipped; ordered by created_at (user rows)

semantics.serializer: no envelope; built by hand in view

resources.purpose: Upload files/images/audio for later attach to a chat turn (multipart), or legacy JSON mount by storage_path.

request.audio_form_fields: model (current main model name, non-empty) and endpoint (Endpoint id int) required when any file content_type starts with audio/
request.legacy_json: {"storage_path": string, "display_name"?: string} (mount path; validated file readability)

success.http_201: partial or full success (any result ok/ok_degraded)
success.http_422: all inputs failed; body adds "error": "all attachments failed"

success.failure_item_fields: input_index, display_name, mime_type, stage, code, message, reason, diagnostics
success.stripping: storage_path / platform_files / part / platform_entry NEVER serialized on POST; diagnostic 'detail' never leaves server

errors.400: {"error": "至少需要一个文件"} | legacy: {"error": "storage_path 不能为空"} / {"error": "文件不存在或不可读: ..."}
errors.422_audio_target: {"attachments": [], "results": [...all failed], "failures": [...], "error": message} code audio_target_required (missing model/endpoint, non-int endpoint, unresolved target)
audio_preflight_codes: audio_model_unsupported (target lacks audio ability or file_uri transport)

semantics.order: results/failures preserve input order by input_index; preflight-failed items get status failed + diagnostic stage 'preflight'

resources.purpose: Stream a local audio original for playback (same-conversation scoped).

success.headers: original audio MIME; Content-Disposition inline filename=original; Cache-Control private, max-age=0

errors.404_unified: {"error": "附件不存在"} for every failure (conversation missing, attachment not in conversation, non-audio mime, no storage_path, unreadable file) - no record-existence leak

semantics.mime_gate: only mime_type startswith audio/; content_url in MessageSerializer.attachments_meta points here for audio rows only
semantics.playback: frontend plays content_url, never Gemini file_uri

frontend_consumers: MessageBubble audio player via attachments_meta content_url (enrichMessages)
shared endpoints conversations.js (no wrapper; direct URL)

resources.purpose: Remove one attachment association (user or tool_collection source) from a conversation.

success.user_source: 204 No Content; SessionAttachment deleted and its id stripped from every Message.attachment_ids of the conversation

errors.400: {"error": "source 须为 'user' 或 'tool_collection'"} | {"error": "id 不能为空"} (tool_collection)
errors.404: {"error": "附件不存在"} (unknown user id / non-int) | {"error": "未找到该工具缓存条目"}
errors.409: {"error": "此附件已冻结在远端缓存中，无法删除。", "detail": ..., "frozen_in_cache": true, "cache_name": ...} when attachment file_uri is frozen in a remote context cache snapshot

semantics.single_item: one source+id per request; no batch delete exists
semantics.semantic: detaches association; actual file bytes GC is separate (legacy storage has no reference-safe GC today - B1 scope)

resources.purpose: Send one chat turn and stream the answer as typed SSE events.

body_fields.content: string (may be empty for pure regenerate)
body_fields.galatea_mcp: bool default false (deprecated field; backend must not splice Galatea MCP declarations)

request.note: galatea_mcp legacy field tolerated but inert for standard live chat (constant use_drawer proxy + per-request manifest)

canonical_events.status: string (phase message; also used for tool progress with {message, args...} shape before blocking tools)
canonical_events.error: typed dict or legacy dict or bare 'internal_error'

success.non_events: delta / tool_call / tool_result / reasoning / reference / anchor_created are NOT emitted by agents/services.py (stale doc names); tool visibility flows as status + telemetry.tool_calls

errors.400: {"error": "你还没输入内容，西娅。"} (empty content, no edit, no attachments) | {"error": "用户身份预设不能用于 Agent 对话"} | {"error": "不支持的 Agent 类型：..."} | {"code": "invalid_endpoint", "error": "endpoint must be an integer"}
errors.404: {"error": "找不到该会话"} | synchronous ValueError -> {"error": str} 404 (generator-path ValueErrors surface as SSE error instead)

sse_error_payloads.typed: {"code", "message", "provider", "model", "endpoint_id", "retryable"} (GatewayError categories auth_error/rate_limited/service_unavailable/protocol_error; TargetResolutionError code target_resolution_error retryable false)
sse_error_payloads.legacy: {"code", "message"} with codes rate_limited | service_unavailable | auth_error | stream_error
sse_error_payloads.tool_loop: codes content_filtered | stream_interrupted | empty_response | cold_finalizer_tool_call | cold_finalizer_empty
sse_error_payloads.internal: bare string 'internal_error' (generator crash fallback -> guard emits {"code": "stream_crashed", ...})

semantics.preference_persist: conversation.thinking_level saved from request unless edit_message_id present
semantics.history_separate: message history is a separate GET (conversation.messages.list); this POST never returns history

frontend_consumers: ChatArea.jsx raw fetch (no mode param -> sse), manual ReadableStream parse; consumes done/telemetry/cache_skipped/error/thinking/reasoning/status; any other event type appends text to content
shared endpoints agents.js chatWithAgent/chatWithAgentStream (?mode=sse; unused wrappers)

success.terminal: done/stopped/error end the poll; error_message carries the typed error dict when available

errors.400: {"error": "message_id is required"}

semantics.delta_polling: cursor is the event index for the next poll; events[from cursor] returned
semantics.async_ack: async POST returns {message_id, status:'processing'}; frontend persists exo_async_<sessionId> localStorage for crash re-entry and replays statusData.events

resources.purpose: Cooperatively stop an in-flight generation (partial content is persisted).

errors.404: {"error": "no active generation found for this session"}

semantics.both_modes: async stop requires message_id; SSE stop fires session-level registry event; stop_event popped after signal

frontend_consumers: ChatArea stop button (SSE bare; async with ?message_id=)

resources.purpose: Edit an earlier user message or regenerate (redo) it; unified entry point.

request.edit: edit_message_id + non-empty content -> overwrite message content, truncate everything after it, re-stream
request.regenerate: edit_message_id + empty/whitespace content -> keep original content, truncate after, re-stream

errors.not_found: ValueError('找不到指定的用户消息') inside generator -> SSE error event data 'internal_error' (NOT a synchronous 404)

semantics.truncation: messages with index >= edit target index+1 deleted; last_summarized_index and cache_end_index rewound
semantics.no_new_user_message: regenerate never creates a duplicate user message; preferences not re-persisted on edit/redo
semantics.note: ReactSheet's separate 'regenerate' endpoint does not exist

resources.purpose: Fork a new independent conversation from an assistant message.

request.branch_from_message_id: int required; must be an assistant message in this conversation

errors.400: {"error": "branch_from_message_id 不能为空"} | ValueError maps -> {"error": "会话不存在" / "找不到指定的 AI 消息" / "没有可复制的有效消息"}

semantics.copy_rule: copies messages with index_in_session <= branch index, keeps newest 21, strips leading non-user messages
semantics.new_conversation: parent_conversation set; last_summarized_index=0; cache_end_index=None; messages re-indexed sequentially
semantics.transactional: partial copy failure rolls back the new conversation

resources.purpose: Inspect or invalidate the conversation's remote context cache.

success.GET_active: {"active": true, "platform", "cache_name", "model", "created_at", "expires_at", "remaining_seconds": int, "renewals": int, "ttl_seconds": int, "has_snapshot": bool[, "snapshot_cache_end_idx": int]}
success.DELETE: 204 No Content (invalidates remote cache + unlinks local cache_chunk_<pk>.json; async snapshot rebuild may spawn)

errors.400: {"error": "Missing 'agent' field"}

semantics.no_bridge_noop: a preset without a bridge session returns 200 {ok: true, message: no-op} rather than an error

success.highlight_path: 201 ChronicleEntrySerializer row (kind='highlight', scope='里'); NOT a MemoryPlasmid
